description:
Starting gate for the single-repo migration (Option B). Eight decisions
must be made and recorded before Phase 0 begins. Some decisions can be
revisited based on Phase 0 audit findings (notably D2a: filter-merge vs
working-tree-only for _project/**, which depends on whether gitleaks finds
anything in _project/**'s history).

This is a no-code item. Output: a one-page decisions doc committed to the
repo so future-you and any collaborators can see why each choice was made.

Plan file: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/single-repo-migration.md

Decisions to make:

- D1: Which GitHub repo URL becomes canonical?
  Recommended: existing joeharris76/BenchBox (current public) stays
  canonical. Archive joeharris76/benchbox-private after dev locus
  migrates. No rename, no visibility flip — avoids the only
  irreversible step.

- D2: Bulk private commit history — preserve or leave behind?
  Recommended: leave behind. Bring working-tree contents only via one
  final curated sync. No concrete archaeological value identified for
  ~year of solo private commits; removes audit burden on every
  wip/hack/temp commit message.

- D2a: TODO/DONE history specifically?
  Recommended: preserve via git filter-repo --path _project/ then merge
  with --allow-unrelated-histories. _project/ contents are decision
  rationale with long-term value. Reconfirm after Phase 0 audit findings.

- D3: Where do _project/TODO and _project/DONE live?
  Recommended: on main, excluded from wheel.

- D4: Where do _blog/drafts/ live?
  Recommended: on main, excluded from wheel; or in a wip/ branch that
  never merges. Working-tree only (no history preserved).

- D5: Merge strategy on main?
  Recommended: squash-merge only — with one explicit exception: the
  Phase 4 _project/** filter-merge PR uses a regular merge commit
  (squashing would defeat the history-preservation purpose).

- D6: Continuous CI surface?
  Recommended: every push to main, every PR.

- D7: Reproducibility apparatus?
  Recommended: keep SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from tag commit; drop the rest of
  the timestamp normalization machinery.

- D8: /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox (private clone) disposition after Phase 5?
  Recommended: rename to BenchBox.retired-YYYYMMDD/ to prevent shell
  muscle-memory mistakes; delete after 60-day soak. Future development
  happens in ~/Developer/benchbox-public (optionally renamed/symlinked
  to /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox if you want the canonical path back).

anti_patterns.dont: defer the decisions doc until after Phase 0
anti_patterns.why: then there is no gate; the audit happens with implicit assumptions instead of explicit choices.
Option B (current public stays canonical) is the load-bearing assumption of the entire plan; if this decision flips back to Option A (rename + flip), the plan and 10 other TODOs need rewriting.
it determines whether Phase 4 includes a filter-merge step or whether _project/** is just working-tree synced. The mechanics differ substantially.

preserves.behavior: The plan file remains the source of truth for the migration; the decisions doc only records the per-decision answers.
This item is a gate, not a refactor. Nothing changes in the codebase except the new decisions doc.

verifications.description: Decisions doc exists and lists all of D1-D8 with explicit choices

work_units.notes:
The plan covers each decision with the recommendation and trade-off.
Spend time on D2/D2a (history strategy) and D4 (drafts location) as
they have the highest variance in possible answers.

Format: one paragraph context, then a table with columns
(ID, Decision, Choice, Reason). Keep under one page.
For each D1-D8: record the choice and a short reason. If you
deviated from the recommendation, write down why.

Lands on private via the curated flow (since dev locus is still on
private at this point). It will arrive on public as part of the
Phase 4 _project/** filter-merge.
